where.if: AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT *, (6371000 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(latitude)) * cos(radians(longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(latitude)))) AS distance FROM campus_poi WHERE (6371000 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(latitude)) * cos(radians(longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(latitude)))) <= #{radius} ORDER BY distance
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campus_poi (name, category, description, latitude, longitude, location, floor, image_url, open_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{category}, #{description}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{longitude}, ' ', #{latitude}, ')'), 4326), #{floor}, #{imageUrl}, #{openTime})
